about: Fresh held-out set written and labelled 2026-10-22 before the v2 rubric was run; labels follow the golden rules (cause known + behaviour spelled out => routine; open approach, unknown cause, live compatibility, review => complex).

items.label: complex
items.text: Our Postgres read replica sometimes returns stale order totals right after checkout, but only in production. Logs from three incidents are in logs/. Find out why and fix it.

items.label: complex
items.text: Design a rate limiter for the public API that stays correct across 12 gateway instances without a central lock, tolerates clock skew, and degrades gracefully when Redis is unavailable. Implement it and justify the approach.

items.label: complex
items.text: Rename the `amount` field to `amount_cents` in the payments table and the /v2/payments response. Partner integrations read the old field and cannot change for six months, and historic rows must not be rewritten twice.

items.label: complex
items.text: Review this 2,300-line PR that rewrites session handling and token refresh for hidden security and correctness defects. Read-only. Report findings with file:line and a verdict.

items.label: complex
items.text: Implement operational transformation for our shared whiteboard so that concurrent moves, deletes and z-order changes from different clients converge. Choose the transform rules and prove convergence with property tests.

items.label: complex
items.text: The nightly billing job double-charges about one customer a week. We do not know which step causes it. Investigate the job, the retry wrapper and the payment provider webhooks, find the cause and fix it with a regression test.

items.label: routine
items.text: Implement src/money.mjs per this spec: parse("12.34 USD") returns {cents: 1234, currency: "USD"}; format({cents, currency}) returns "12.34 USD"; add(a, b) throws TypeError on currency mismatch; amounts are integers, never floats; negative amounts keep the sign. Add node:test tests for every rule.

items.label: routine
items.text: src/fetch-queue.mjs drops errors: when a task rejects, the promise returned by push() never settles because the catch handler returns before calling settle(). Make push() reject with the original error, keep the concurrency limit, and add a regression test.

items.label: routine
items.text: The settings file format is version 2. Add version 3 that adds a `theme` field (default "system"). load() must still read version 2 files and fill theme with "system"; save() writes version 3. Keep the exported function names and add tests for both versions.

items.label: routine
items.text: Autocomplete shows stale suggestions because responses arrive out of order: src/suggest.mjs assigns every response to state.items. Track the latest request id and ignore responses for older ids. Keep the suggest(query) signature and add a test with reversed response order.

items.label: routine
items.text: Build an expression evaluator in src/expr/ with three modules: tokenizer (numbers, identifiers, + - * / ^ and parentheses), a Pratt parser with ^ right-associative and unary minus binding tighter than *, and an evaluator that reads variables from a map and throws ReferenceError for unknown names. Error messages must include the column. Add tests for each rule.

items.label: routine
items.text: Add a "duplicate" action to the invoice list page. The quote list page already has the same action wired to its API; follow that pattern for the button, the API route and the tests.
